rubric_items.reason: Prior F-2 to F-5 are fixed: 21-doctor unpaged suite, Dr. Same id tie-break, Inactive earlier-slot doctor, AC1 relabel. S-6 AC4 and a router check were added. S-6 AC2/AC3 (empty and Cancelled-only day schedule) lean on APT-6, which never reads the day schedule.

Assertions check observable results: exact toEqual on entries and slots, exact key sets, ordered names, id order for same-name ties, length 21 with keys ['items'], and status plus error message on failures. Minor gaps: medicalNotes is not checked, and the malformed-id test checks only the status.

Covers 404 (NOT_FOUND), 400 for a malformed id, 400 'specialization is Inactive', today+6 and today+7 boundaries, the UTC-midnight zone case, started slots, booked and Cancelled slots, ties with and without slots, and an empty list.

Vitest and Supertest with an injected fixed clock. Each suite gets a fresh database, guarded by skipIf(!pgAvailable()). The file is in api/test, titles start with 'HMS-11 REQ-n' like the neighbouring ticket tests, and fixture data is invented.

Gives no pass or coverage numbers and leaves them to the verifier (H3). The stated 17 tests in three suites matches the file (15+1+1). checks.json shows test pass and coverage skip (exit 78), as C4 says. Only the test file changed.

findings.text: C9 says APT-10 and APT-6 pin the day schedule for booked, empty and Cancelled dates. APT-6 never reads /slots: it cancels and then books 11:00. No test reads the day schedule for a Cancelled-only date or a date with no appointment (S-6 AC3, AC2), yet doctorService.ts changed.

cites.quote: the day schedule for booked, empty and cancelled dates stays pinned by the existing APT-10 and APT-6 tests (C9)
Given a doctor and date with only a Cancelled appointment, when staff read that day schedule before and after the change, then both responses are the same.

findings.suggested_fix: Add HMS-11 REQ-16 (S-6 AC2, AC3) tests that GET /api/doctors/:id/slots for a date with no appointment and for one with only a Cancelled appointment, and assert the exact slot states. Or correct C9 and the S-6 entry under Known.

findings.text: S-5 AC2 also forbids medical notes. The booked-slot test checks for the patient name and the allergy (Penicillin) but not the fixture's medicalNotes value, 'Invented note'.

cites.quote: then the response has no patient name, allergies, notes or other medical history

findings.suggested_fix: Add expect(text).not.toContain('Invented note') to the booked-slot test.

findings.text: The malformed-id test asserts only the 400 status. Unlike the 404 test, it does not check the error code, so any 400 passes.
findings.suggested_fix: Also assert res.body.error.code for the malformed id, using the code that parseId returns.

cites.quote: API tests use Vitest and Supertest against a throwaway PostgreSQL 16 with a fixed clock.
Every PRD requirement has at least one test whose name starts with its ID (DOC-1, APT-4, ...).
Without either, database tests are skipped.
The verifier skips coverage (the project has no coverage script), so no run reports coverage.
The route is added to the existing `specializationsRouter`.
Name ties compare ignoring case, with `doctor id as the final tie-break`.
APT-6: cancels with a required reason, and the slot is free again
